origin.description: Extract the first regular-expression match from each string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Character vector of regular expressions. An empty pattern is not supported.

arguments.name: opts_regex
arguments.text: A list of regex settings, or NULL for the defaults.

origin.details: A missing string or pattern, or an empty pattern, yields a missing result, and an empty pattern warns. An empty string is searched. The inputs are recycled to the longer length. A string with no match yields NA. opts_regex holds only the settings that were supplied. Named arguments are merged into that dict and passed through stri_opts_regex. A repeated name is an error. An unknown name in a bare dict warns and is ignored. case_insensitive, comments, dotall (also dot_all), literal, multiline (also multi_line), unix_lines, and uword are ICU flags. error_on_unknown_escapes rejects an unknown backslash. time_limit and stack_limit are applied only when they are positive.
origin.value: A character vector. A missing result is NA.

translation.description: Extract the first regular-expression match from each string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Regular expression, missing value, or list of those. An empty pattern yields NA.

arguments.name: opts_regex
arguments.text: None, or a dict of only the regex settings that were supplied.

translation.details: A missing string or pattern, or an empty pattern, yields a missing result, and an empty pattern warns. An empty string is searched. The inputs are recycled to the longer length. A string with no match yields NA. opts_regex holds only the settings that were supplied. Named arguments are merged into that dict and passed through stri_opts_regex. A repeated name is an error. An unknown name in a bare dict warns and is ignored. case_insensitive, comments, dotall (also dot_all), literal, multiline (also multi_line), unix_lines, and uword are ICU flags. error_on_unknown_escapes rejects an unknown backslash. time_limit and stack_limit are applied only when they are positive.
translation.value: A list of strings. A missing result is NA.
translation.example:
from stringi.regex import stri_extract_first_regex
result = stri_extract_first_regex("XaaaaX", "a+")
print(f'stri_extract_first_regex("XaaaaX", "a+") returns {result[0]}.')
